rows.label: Optimus Prime
rows.hook: is the noble truck-transforming leader of the heroic Autobots

rows.label: Ultron
rows.hook: is a robot villain who turns on his creator and tries to wipe out humanity to bring peace

rows.label: HAL 9000
rows.description: fictional character in Arthur C. Clarke's Space Odyssey series
rows.hook: is the calm, red-eyed shipboard computer that turns on its crew and refuses to open the pod bay doors

rows.label: Vision
rows.hook: is a synthetic android hero who joins the Avengers after being built by a villain

rows.label: J.A.R.V.I.S.
rows.description: Fictional Artificial intelligence appearing in Marvel Comics
rows.hook: is Tony Stark's witty AI butler who helps run his Iron Man suits

rows.label: Megatron
rows.hook: is the tyrannical leader of the villainous Decepticons and archenemy of the Autobots

rows.label: Curiosity
rows.description: American robotic rover exploring Gale Crater on Mars
rows.hook: is a car-sized rover that explores Gale Crater and a tall mountain at its center

rows.label: Perseverance
rows.description: American robotic rover exploring Jezero Crater on Mars
rows.hook: is a car-sized rover hunting for signs of ancient life in an old river delta

rows.label: T-1000
rows.description: robotic antagonist in the film "Terminator 2: Judgment Day"
rows.hook: is a shape-shifting liquid-metal killer sent back in time to hunt young John Connor

rows.label: Bumblebee
rows.hook: is the small yellow Autobot who transforms into a Volkswagen Beetle or a Camaro

rows.label: Starscream
rows.hook: is the treacherous, jet-transforming second-in-command of the Decepticons who schemes against his leader

rows.label: Opportunity
rows.hook: is the long-lived rover nicknamed Oppy that kept driving for 14 years on a 90-day mission

rows.label: Furby
rows.hook: is a furry owl-like electronic toy that speaks its own language and was a must-have holiday gift

rows.label: Data
rows.description: fictional character in the fictional Star Trek universe
rows.hook: is the pale, curious android officer on the USS Enterprise who longs to be human

rows.label: GLaDOS
rows.description: fictional artificially intelligent computer system in the Portal series of video games
